proposed.title: Superuser with empty roles bypasses role list permission checks
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: GET /api/v1/role/list returned HTTP 200 with full role management data for a token whose user is is_superuser=True and roles=[]. TC_ROLE_API_009 assert_ideal expects DependPermission to deny this persona with HTTP 403. Other auth legs (no-token, limited unbound, no-role non-superuser) passed before this assertion failed, indicating PermissionControl short-circuits on is_superuser without requiring role/API bindings.

candidates.recommended_action: Confirm DependPermission/PermissionControl superuser short-circuit on role APIs; require role bindings or return 403 for empty-role superuser.

proposed.title: Role update returns 500 on role.name UNIQUE constraint
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: POST /api/v1/role/update with a colliding role.name returns IntegrityError UNIQUE constraint failed: role.name as HTTP 500 instead of a 4xx conflict/validation response. Observed in TC_ROLE_API_012 (assert_ideal duplicate rename) and TC_ROLE_FUZZ_002 (schema fuzz reused existing names such as seeded admin role name). Update path lacks an application-level uniqueness precheck.

candidates.recommended_action: Add role.name uniqueness precheck on update and map conflicts to 4xx; keep fuzz robustness expecting status_code < 500.

proposed.title: Role authorized with non-existent menu_ids returns HTTP 500
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: POST /api/v1/role/authorized with menu_ids containing a non-existent menu id returned bare Internal Server Error (HTTP 500) in TC_ROLE_API_013. Invalid binding arrays are not validated to a client/business error before an unhandled server failure; assert_ideal expects 4xx and retention of prior menu bindings.

candidates.recommended_action: Validate menu_ids existence before M2M update; reject missing ids with 4xx and leave prior menus unchanged.

proposed.title: Role authorized with invalid api_infos returns HTTP 500
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: POST /api/v1/role/authorized with api_infos referencing a non-existent path/method pair returned bare Internal Server Error (HTTP 500) in TC_ROLE_API_014. Missing API-row existence validation allows unhandled server failures instead of 4xx reject-and-retain semantics for prior bindings.

candidates.recommended_action: Validate api_infos against existing API rows before binding; reject missing pairs with 4xx and retain prior apis.

proposed.title: Role name exceeding ORM max_length returns HTTP 500 instead of client error
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: POST /api/v1/role/create with a name longer than Role.name ORM max_length=20 returned bare HTTP 500 Internal Server Error in TC_ROLE_API_015. Request schema appears to lack matching max_length validation, so overlong names reach the DB/ORM and surface as unhandled server failures instead of client/validation errors.

candidates.recommended_action: Enforce Role.name max_length in the create schema/controller and return 4xx for overlong names.

proposed.title: Role authorized returns HTTP 500 on invalid menu_ids element type
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: Schemathesis fuzz for POST /api/v1/role/authorized (TC_ROLE_FUZZ_003) produced Internal Server Error when menu_ids contained a boolean False. Invalid binding element types are not rejected as 4xx before an uncaught server failure; robustness contract requires status_code < 500.

candidates.recommended_action: Tighten menu_ids item type validation to integers and return 4xx for schema-invalid elements.

proposed.title: Role domain factories missing from L1 knowledge registry
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: API-PLAN-FINDING-001: .aa/data-knowledge.yaml lacks formal capabilities.domain_factories.role while tests/testdata/domain/role.py (make_role/bind_role_apis/cleanup_role) exists and adapters.api.role is registered. Codegen that trusts only L1 may omit or reinvent factories.

candidates.recommended_action: Promote domain_factories.role (and related cleanup symbols) into L1 knowledge to match on-disk modules.

proposed.title: API adapters.menu helpers missing from L1 knowledge registry
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: API-PLAN-FINDING-002: capabilities.adapters.api.menu is not registered in .aa/data-knowledge.yaml while tests/api/adapters/menu.py exists and is required by role authorized/filter scenarios (007/008/013). Plan correctly maps ownership=reuse for the on-disk adapter.

candidates.recommended_action: Register adapters.api.menu in L1 knowledge; codegen should continue importing tests.api.adapters.menu directly.

proposed.title: E2E role adapters and domain_factories.role missing from L1 knowledge registry
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: PLAN-FINDING-KNOWLEDGE-001: .aa/data-knowledge.yaml lacks formal capabilities.domain_factories.role and capabilities.adapters.e2e.role. Role E2E seed/cleanup uses on-disk tests/e2e/adapters/role.py while L1 only registers capabilities.adapters.api.role.*. Codegen that trusts only L1 may omit the E2E seed bridge.

candidates.recommended_action: Promote adapters.e2e.role and domain_factories.role into L1; keep codegen reusing on-disk E2E adapters.

proposed.title: Fuzz role adapters and domain_factories.role missing from L1 knowledge registry
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: FUZZ-PLAN-FINDING-KNOWLEDGE-001: .aa/data-knowledge.yaml lacks formal capabilities.domain_factories.role and capabilities.adapters.fuzz.role (adapters.fuzz covers dept/menu/user only). On-disk assets exist under tests/fuzz/adapters/role.py and tests/testdata/domain/role.py.

candidates.recommended_action: Register adapters.fuzz.role and domain_factories.role in L1; reuse on-disk fuzz adapters/strategies.

proposed.title: Role assert-ideal negative contracts diverge from current product error shapes
proposed.root_cause_hypothesis: CASE-FINDING-ASSERT-IDEAL-001: TC_ROLE_API_012/013/014 pin assert_ideal uniqueness and authorized-reject/retain semantics while Explore notes update uniqueness and authorized FK/existence checks may be missing. Batch execution failures for those cases confirm this contract/intent risk beside the product defects; not a missing-coverage item.

candidates.recommended_action: Keep ideal negatives for product-alignment signals unless owners explicitly switch assertion_intent to assert_current.
